note: Bounded pilot inventory. THREE instruments: the Income Tax Ordinance, the National Insurance Law and — added for the contributions leg — the National Health Insurance Law, which the Israel corpus scope does NOT contain. A listed instrument is NOT fully encoded; encoded_sections names exactly what this repository covers and a repository test enforces that every listed section has a module on disk. No Israel corpus release exists, so no release is bound and .axiom/toolchain.toml is absent.
